description: This file defines a final class 'Utils' providing various static utility methods for the GuzzleHttp library, including type description, header parsing, resource handling, handler selection, system configuration retrieval, header normalization, proxy checks, JSON encoding/decoding, time measurement, and IDN URI conversion.

classes.name: GuzzleHttp\Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for various common tasks in the GuzzleHttp library, including type description, header parsing, handler selection, system configuration, JSON handling, time measurement, and IDN URI conversion.

methods.name: describeType
methods.description: Returns a string describing the type and class of the input variable.

methods.name: headersFromLines
methods.description: Parses an iterable of header lines into an associative array of headers.

methods.name: debugResource
methods.description: Returns a resource suitable for debugging output based on the provided value.

methods.name: chooseHandler
methods.description: Selects and creates a default HTTP handler based on system capabilities and environment.

methods.name: defaultUserAgent
methods.description: Generates a default User-Agent string for GuzzleHttp.

methods.name: defaultCaBundle
methods.description: Determines the default CA certificate bundle path for the system.

methods.name: normalizeHeaderKeys
methods.description: Creates a mapping of header names lowercased to their original casing.

methods.name: isHostInNoProxy
methods.description: Checks if a given host matches any pattern in the no-proxy list.

methods.name: jsonDecode
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a PHP variable, throwing an exception on error.

methods.name: jsonEncode
methods.description: Encodes a PHP variable into a JSON string, throwing an exception on error.

methods.name: currentTime
methods.description: Returns the current time as a float, using hrtime or microtime.

methods.name: idnUriConvert
methods.description: Converts an IDN URI host to ASCII form if necessary, throws on error.
